[[File:DoubleChunkCookieNom.ogg]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Brrr cold|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Double Chunk Cookie''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious and c4rype. The emote is not looped, ending after being interacted with four times. No music can be heard while performing this emote, though sounds of a person speaking and eating can be heard. '''Double Chunk Cookie''' makes the player pull out a giant chocolate chip cookie while saying, "Mmmm! Quad Chunk Chocolate Cookie!" The cookie is held with both hands. *On the first interaction, the player takes a bite, triggering a "Nom" sound effect. *On the second interaction, the player rotates the cookie and takes another bite with the same sound. *On the third interaction, it causes another rotation, another bite, and once again the "Nom" sound. *On the fourth interaction, a new animation plays, showing the player holding a tiny piece of the cookie in the left hand. *On the final interaction, the remaining piece is tossed into the player's face, playing the "Nom" sound effect one last time to end the emote. This emote could be obtained at Level 7 of the premium track, where it costed {{Bell|180}} or {{Robux|84}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Bell|700}} or {{Robux|406}}. ==Trivia== *Due to a bug, this emote shares the same description as the [[Chilly (Emote)|Chilly]] emote. *This emote is likely a reference to the ''Double Chunk Chocolate Cookie'', an item sold in [https://www.costco.com/ Costco]. **This item was popularized by the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/were-costco-guys Costco Guys] on their social media pages. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Double Chunk Cookie''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Double Chunk Cookie''' shares the same description as the [[Chilly (Emote)|Chilly Emote]]. **{{Bug}} Going into first person then into third person after a part of the cookie has been eaten will visually reset the cookie. **{{Bug}} Cookie is not visible in the inventory emote preview. **{{Bug}} Sound is affected by [[Time Scale]]. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **Removed fybirr from emote credits, replaced with c4rype. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.52.0|v1.52.4b]] **'''Double Chunk Cookie''' is no longer obtainable. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Cookie is now visible in the inventory emote preview. {{EmoteNavBox}}
